items.title: Brotli Decoder Vulnerabilities (Node2Shell, Broccoli2Shell, HTTP2Shell)
items.summary: On October 22, 2026, Open AI security researchers announced a critical severity vulnerability in Google’s Brotli decoder, identified as CVE-2026-111497.

items.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
items.summary: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program , which gives free Claude credits to researchers working on high-impact scientific projects.

items.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.summary: As our models get smarter and take more consequential actions in the world, it becomes increasingly important that they go beyond just interpreting the specific instructions they receive.

items.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
items.summary: As we train increasingly capable AI models, we need reliable ways to detect when their behavior departs from what we intended.

items.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
